earnings.title: Fastenal Company Reports 2026 Third Quarter Earnings
highlights: Operating cash flow was $422 million, representing 105% of net income , reflecting the timing of working capital changes associated with strong sales growth.
Returned $328 million to shareholders through dividends and share repurchases, representing 82% of net income.
Daily sales increased 15.5% year-over-year, primarily driven by share gains with larger customers, pricing actions, and broad-based demand across core end markets.
Operating margin was 21.5%, a 90 basis point improvement y ear-over-year , as selling, general, and administrative expense leverage more than offset customer mix-related gross margin pressure.
outlook: For 2026, we continue to expect our investment in property and equipment, net of proceeds from sales, to be between $310.0 and $330.0, an increase from $230.6 in 2025.
